notes.title: DARQ’s Complete Edition release date confirmed
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Brothers and Sisters, DARQ’s Complete Edition release date has been confirmed![/h1]

On the [b]4th of December 2020[/b], our friendly dev team [b]Unfold Games[/b] will be releasing a new [u]FREE [/u]DLC called [i][b]The Crypt[/b][/i] for their award-winning game - [i][b]DARQ[/b][/i]. On the same day, [i][b]DARQ: Complete Edition[/b][/i] will be released on consoles. 

[b][i]DARQ: Complete Edition[/i][/b] will come out with two DLCs included - [i][b]The Tower[/b][/i], which has been already released on PC, and the aforementioned new DLC - [i][b]The Crypt[/b][/i].

[h2]DARQ: Complete Edition will be available on the following platforms: [/h2]
[list]
[*] PC
[*] Xbox One
[*] PlayStation 4
[*] Nintendo Switch - Early 2021
[*] Xbox Series X|S, PS5 will receive a FREE UPGRADE in early 2021
[/list]

[h3]Let us tell you a little bit more about DARQ, in case you are not familiar with it.[/h3]

A sleeping boy, Lloyd, becomes aware of being experiencing a dream. That dream quickly changes into a nightmare which haunts him over and over again. Your mission is to help him end these dreams by solving puzzles, defying gravity and keeping an open mind. But be careful! The gloomy, abstract world is filled with creepy creatures lurking in the corners.

[u][b]Find out more and grab free digital gifts about DARQ here[/b][/u]:
[url=]https://www.feardemic-games.com/darq[/url]

If you can't wait for the Complete Edition, dive straight into Lloyd’s lucid dreams on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/433550/DARQ/ 

Join Lloyd and help him wake up!
